title: panel quorum leg — one plan as plan elements
description: Output contract of one quorum panel leg. It carries references/quorum/prompts/plan.schema.json's plan with summary as a mode field and every step, risk, assumption and open question as one entry of items, tagged by kind, so each plan element gets its own id (<lab>-<n>, assigned by the classifier by position) and synthesis can account for every one. A field a kind does not use is the empty string (depends_on: the empty array).

summary.description: The approach in one short paragraph.

items.description: Steps first in execution order, then risks by severity, then assumptions, then open questions.

title.description: step: short title for the step. risk: what breaks, lands out of order, or is hard to reverse. assumption: the fact relied on, or the ambiguity resolved by fiat. open_question: what must be answered.

what.description: step: the change and how it is verified. Empty string for the other kinds.

where.description: step: files, repos, or systems touched — from the grounding pack when one exists. open_question: by whom or from where it is answered. Empty string for the other kinds.

depends_on.description: step: titles of prior steps this one needs. Empty for the other kinds and for a step that needs none.

mitigation.description: risk: how the plan contains it. Empty string for the other kinds.
